name: Torre Picasso

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/11089668 (centroid of the outline; long axis at 4.0°)

rights.note: Designed by Minoru Yamasaki in 1974 (adapted to Spanish regulations by Jorge Mir Valls and Rafael Coll Pujol); final design and site work by the studio of Genaro Alas and Pedro Casariego; engineer Fernando Cid García; built 1980–1988 by FCC, opened January 1989. Yamasaki died in 1986: protected in Spain until 2066.

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1364394_torre_picasso.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Main façade (+Z) = the south face over the Plaza de Pablo Ruiz Picasso, with the great elliptical entrance arch in the stone podium. White aluminium piers with 13 (short faces) / 17 (long faces) recessed window strips, dark glass in the notched corners, a plain white crown band with a slight flare, the west addition (stairs and shaft) up to 146 m, and a heliport on the lift block on the roof. Podium height (10.5 m), arch size (22 × 9.2 m), crown (147.5–157 m), window counts and the round-headed windows of the podium measured on photos (±5–10 %). Panel joints, the AZCA podium and plaza levels around the tower are not modelled.
